build_detection_train_loader: build a DensePose training data loader from a Detectron2 config with optional custom dataset mapper
build_detection_test_loader: build a DensePose test data loader for a named dataset using the given config and mapper
combine_detection_dataset_dicts: combine and filter dataset dicts from multiple datasets with optional instance predicate and proposal files
build_inference_based_loader: build an inference-based data loader from model predictions using bootstrap dataset config and optional embedder
build_data_sampler: build a data sampler for DensePose predictions with configurable uniform or confidence-based sampling strategy
